name: School Bus
summary: Yellow school bus with long bonnet, black stripes and folded stop-sign arm, side view; for school scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tyres stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 900 px wide and 430 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the body bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the bus faces left

author: krakujs
